extractions.value: Paraneoplastic stiff-man syndrome associated with mediastinal undifferentiated carcinoma. Anti-GAD and anti-amphiphysin antibodies both negative. Symptoms improved after tumor resection. Reflex myoclonus of head/neck originated from brainstem (latency 15 ms), while lower-limb myoclonus originated from lumbar spinal cord level (latency 41 ms). Antinuclear antibody was speckled at 160x. Tetanus antibody slightly elevated at 0.31 IU/mL attributed to prior tetanus toxoid use.
extractions.quote: These findings suggest that this stiff-man syndrome may occur as an autoimmune paraneoplastic syndrome of CNS.
